title: Governing (theory → governance, bound over a collective)
description: Governing selects a governance theory (one object of Gov) and binds it over a collective. Generator of the governance object. orchestrating is governing restricted to the orchestration theory. Per docs/ORCHESTRATION-GENEALOGY.md; grounded in the lab surveys (orchestration-vs-choreography, kyriarchical-agentics, tiyospaye/wolakȟota).
